<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_WorkLiveAustria" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/work-live-austria">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkLiveAustria">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Applicant (Work and Live in Austria)" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Representation" name="Austrian Representation Office (BMEIA)"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_SubmitApplication" name="Visa application" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Participant_Representation" messageRef="Msg_ApplicationSubmitted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DocsRequested" name="Additional documents requested" sourceRef="Participant_Representation" targetRef="Event_DocsRequested" messageRef="Msg_AdditionalDocsRequested"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_VisaIssued" name="Visa issued" sourceRef="Participant_Representation" targetRef="Event_VisaIssued" messageRef="Msg_VisaIssued"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_VisaRefused" name="Visa refused" sourceRef="Participant_Representation" targetRef="Event_VisaRefused" messageRef="Msg_VisaRefused"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_DocsProvided" name="Additional documents provided" sourceRef="Task_ProvideAdditional" targetRef="Participant_Representation" messageRef="Msg_AdditionalDocsProvided"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ApplicationSubmitted" name="Visa application submitted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_AdditionalDocsRequested" name="Additional documents requested"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_AdditionalDocsProvided" name="Additional documents provided"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_VisaIssued" name="Visa issued"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_VisaRefused" name="Visa refused"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Work and Live in Austria - Applicant" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Applicant" name="Plan to work and live in Austria">
      <bpmn:outgoing>SF_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRequirements" name="Check requirements for working and living in Austria"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Setup_Split" name="Split setup steps"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Accommodation" name="Organize accommodation (negotiate)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BankAccount" name="Organize bank account (negotiate)"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Setup_Join" name="Setup steps completed"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Cycle_Merge" name="Start visa application cycle"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Competence_Split" name="Visa category and competent representation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepTypeD" name="Identify competent Austrian representation by place of residence (centre of interest, Section 8 FPG)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepCategoryAC" name="Identify representation of consular district of legal residence"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepSchengen" name="Identify representation of main travel destination or first Schengen entry country"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Competence_Join" name="Competent representation identified"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Docs_Split" name="Prepare visa documents"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteForm" name="Complete visa application form"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckTravelDocument" name="Check travel document (valid beyond stay by 3 months, 2 empty pages, issued within last 10 years)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PassportPhoto" name="Provide passport photo (portrait, 35 x 45 mm, per photo criteria)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HealthInsurance" name="Obtain fully comprehensive travel health insurance (EUR 30,000 cover, valid Schengen area, full stay)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProofSubsistence" name="Prove sufficient means of subsistence for stay and return journey"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OtherEvidence" name="Gather other requested evidence (e.g. hotel reservations, invitations, return ticket, proof of gainful employment)"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Docs_Join" name="Documents prepared"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit visa application"/>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_Response" name="Await representation response"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DocsRequested" name="Additional documents requested">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DocsRequested" messageRef="Msg_AdditionalDocsRequested"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideAdditional" name="Provide additional documents"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_VisaIssued" name="Visa issued">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_VisaIssued" messageRef="Msg_VisaIssued"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_VisaRefused" name="Visa refused">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_VisaRefused" messageRef="Msg_VisaRefused"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Refused" name="Visa application refused"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_RenewalTimer" name="Wait for renewal interval (every x months)">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_Renewal"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Renewal_Split" name="Renewal required?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_CycleEnds" name="Residence cycle ends"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_01" sourceRef="Start_Applicant" targetRef="Task_CheckRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_02" sourceRef="Task_CheckRequirements" targetRef="Gateway_Setup_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_03" sourceRef="Gateway_Setup_Split" targetRef="Task_Accommodation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_04" sourceRef="Gateway_Setup_Split" targetRef="Task_BankAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_05" sourceRef="Task_Accommodation" targetRef="Gateway_Setup_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_06" sourceRef="Task_BankAccount" targetRef="Gateway_Setup_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_07" sourceRef="Gateway_Setup_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Cycle_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_08" sourceRef="Gateway_Cycle_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Competence_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_09" name="Type D visa" sourceRef="Gateway_Competence_Split" targetRef="Task_RepTypeD"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_10" name="Category A or C visa" sourceRef="Gateway_Competence_Split" targetRef="Task_RepCategoryAC"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_11" name="Schengen visa" sourceRef="Gateway_Competence_Split" targetRef="Task_RepSchengen"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_12" sourceRef="Task_RepTypeD" targetRef="Gateway_Competence_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_13" sourceRef="Task_RepCategoryAC" targetRef="Gateway_Competence_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_14" sourceRef="Task_RepSchengen" targetRef="Gateway_Competence_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_15" sourceRef="Gateway_Competence_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_16" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_CompleteForm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_17" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_18" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_PassportPhoto"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_19" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_HealthInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_20" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_ProofSubsistence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_21" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Split" targetRef="Task_OtherEvidence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_22" sourceRef="Task_CompleteForm" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_23" sourceRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_24" sourceRef="Task_PassportPhoto" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_25" sourceRef="Task_HealthInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_26" sourceRef="Task_ProofSubsistence" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_27" sourceRef="Task_OtherEvidence" targetRef="Gateway_Docs_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_28" sourceRef="Gateway_Docs_Join" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_29" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Gateway_Response"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_30" sourceRef="Gateway_Response" targetRef="Event_DocsRequested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_31" sourceRef="Gateway_Response" targetRef="Event_VisaIssued"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_32" sourceRef="Gateway_Response" targetRef="Event_VisaRefused"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_33" sourceRef="Event_DocsRequested" targetRef="Task_ProvideAdditional"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_34" sourceRef="Task_ProvideAdditional" targetRef="Gateway_Response"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_35" sourceRef="Event_VisaRefused" targetRef="End_Refused"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_36" sourceRef="Event_VisaIssued" targetRef="Event_RenewalTimer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_37" sourceRef="Event_RenewalTimer" targetRef="Gateway_Renewal_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_38" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Renewal_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Cycle_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_39" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Renewal_Split" targetRef="End_CycleEnds"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
